svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. A layer that does not exist — ML, SIA, a queue — is drawn as a note, never as an implemented step.
The refresh is synchronous and unconditional. Its failure boundary is shared with the triggering mutation, not isolated from it.
